scope: Dimensionless sensitivity studies authorized by user. No measured component values, laboratory validation, calibrated physical noise, or demonstrated transfer of a Josephson mechanism to fluids.

noise.noise_model: All resistors at the same dimensionless temperature; covariance of phase increments is 2 Gamma M^-1 dt. Additive stochastic Heun; fine and coarse paths use summed Brownian increments.

capacitance.scope: Exactly synchronized two-junction invariant branch, initialized with equal junction phases and zero velocities; not arbitrary phase configurations. LRC loading remains future work.

prediction.target: Difference in future mean total voltage between changed-current and unchanged clones
prediction.null: Run-wise shuffled histories, independently shuffled in each split; preserve all rows of a run together
prediction.split_unit: Independent initial phase pair; no test data used in scaling, model selection or training

fluid_replication.physical_protocol: Reuse the prior 3D Navier-Stokes forcing-shutoff pilot, with exactly its numerical parameters and physical observables. Train/select on recorded original train/validation runs, evaluate on 12 newly simulated independent initial fields.
fluid_replication.target: Integrated normalized energy difference from unchanged forcing over time 0..8
fluid_replication.interpretation: Independent fluid forecast replication, not evidence for Josephson phase-orbit physics in water
